title: Asiad: John Cabang Tolentino through to finals of men's 110-m hurdles
summary: Olympian John Cabang Tolentino surged to a season-best time of 13.58 seconds en route to a place in the final of the men's 110-meter hurdles in the 2026 Asian Games.
